blocks.text: Real-world analogue: The shallow mirror of Salar de Uyuni, tidal mirror beaches, reflecting pools, calm lake shores, and dark volcanic sand that holds a temporary sky.
World relation: Open World exchange and Continuity synchronization. The shore is a meeting boundary, not a storage vault containing the whole visitor.
Connection to newer locations: It relates to the Salt Mirror Archive, River of Deferred Reflections, Archipelago of Borrowed Horizons, Repeated Beach, and Dormant External Gate.

Abstract or metaphorical relation: A save record is a reflection produced by relationship. It can help two sides recognize where they last met without owning or replacing the full life on either shore.
